name: skyrig
description: Weather-aware truck routing — React (Vite) + Django monorepo

scripts.api:dev: uv run --directory apps/api python manage.py runserver 8000
scripts.api:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api python manage.py migrate
scripts.api:lint: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.api:format: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check --fix . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format .
